custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the foreground grass and the rabbit's face. AI models often struggle with thin occluders like grass blades, resulting in 'melting' or incorrect depth ordering. Also, scrutinize the text at the bottom; if it is nonsensical, it is a strong indicator of generation. The Router marked many checkpoints as untestable due to occlusion; ensure this was justified and not an avoidance of difficult anatomy checks.
